aiFailure.tooLarge.description: A request to an AI service failed: the sound sent was larger than the service takes (HTTP 413). {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.server.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service had an error of its own. {status} is the HTTP status number, kept in Latin digits. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.rejectedSaying.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service refused the request (HTTP 400). {detail} is the service's own message, as it wrote it. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.rejected.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service refused the request (HTTP 400) without saying why. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.failedSaying.description: A request to an AI service failed: any other failure. {detail} is what went wrong, as the service or the system wrote it. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.failed.description: A request to an AI service failed: any other failure, with nothing more to say. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

localCaptions.reason.missing.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". Part of the app is missing.

localCaptions.reason.cpu.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". The processor is too old.

localCaptions.reason.blocked.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". Windows or an antivirus refused to start it.

localCaptions.reason.failed.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". It did not start for another reason.

localCaptions.unavailable.missing.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine is missing from this copy of Flown.

localCaptions.unavailable.cpu.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the processor cannot run the speech engine.

localCaptions.unavailable.blocked.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): Windows or an antivirus refused to start the speech engine.

localCaptions.unavailable.failed.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine did not start.

localCaptions.tierLabel.description: A speech model as the Captions tab names it: its tier (Fast, Standard, Accurate, Most accurate, Bangla) and then the model's own name once, in brackets ("Standard (Whisper base)").

localCaptions.noModel.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model is not downloaded. {model} names it ("Standard (Whisper base)"); {size} its download size ("142 MB").

localCaptions.damaged.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model file failed its check. {model} names it; {size} its download size.

localCaptions.crashedAt.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine crashed twice on one part. {part} and {parts} are numbers; "Generate captions" names the button.

localCaptions.crashed.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine crashed twice. "Generate captions" names the button.

localCaptions.memoryTry.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the PC ran out of memory. {model} names the model; {tier} the next quicker tier ("Standard").

localCaptions.memory.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the PC ran out of memory and there is no quicker tier. {model} names the model.

localCaptions.stalled.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine stopped answering. "Generate captions" names the button.

localCaptions.protocol.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine gave an answer Flown cannot read.

localCaptions.language.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model does not know the spoken language asked for. {language} is its code; "Detect automatically" names a choice of the spoken language list.

localCaptions.blockedMemory.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model may not run on this PC for lack of memory. {model} names it; {gb} is a number.

localCaptions.blockedProcessor.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model would be too slow on this processor. {model} names it.

localCaptions.outdated.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the bundled speech engine is from another version of Flown. {model} names the model.

localCaptions.modelProcessor.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why a speech model cannot be downloaded on this PC (its processor).

localCaptions.modelMemory.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why a speech model cannot be downloaded on this PC (its memory). {need} is a decimal number of GB, {gb} and {have} whole numbers.

pinnedDownload.notAllowed.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the address is not one Flown downloads from.

pinnedDownload.space.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the disk has too little free space. {mb} is a whole number of megabytes.

pinnedDownload.stalled.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: nothing arrived for a minute.

pinnedDownload.tooManyRedirects.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent it on too many times.

pinnedDownload.badRedirect.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent it on to an address that is not valid.

pinnedDownload.hostNotAllowed.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent it on to a host Flown does not download from. {host} is that host's name.

pinnedDownload.busy.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server stayed busy longer than Flown waits.

pinnedDownload.refused.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server or a proxy refused it.

pinnedDownload.missing.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the file is gone from its address. {status} is the HTTP status number.

pinnedDownload.httpStatus.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server answered with an error. {status} is the HTTP status number.

pinnedDownload.differentFile.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent another file when the download continued.

pinnedDownload.cannotContinue.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server could not continue a download that had stopped.

pinnedDownload.tooLarge.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: more arrived than the file's size.

pinnedDownload.notSaved.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the file could not be written. {reason} is the system's own message.

pinnedDownload.closedEarly.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the connection closed early.

pinnedDownload.mismatch.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the file did not match its checksum.

localAiDownload.needsMemory.description: Settings › AI on this PC: a model cannot be downloaded because this PC has too little memory. {need} and {have} are whole numbers of GB.

audioAnalysis.unreadableExit.description: Sound measurement failed and the decoder wrote nothing: {file} is a recording file name, {code} the decoder's exit code (a number, kept in Latin digits).
